 Showers Increasing Heading into a New Month 
 Storm Team 9’s Thursday Evening Forecast 
 Madelyn's Evening Forecast 10/29/2026 By Madelyn Hess Published : Oct. 29, 2026 at 5:08 PM EDT | Updated : Oct. 29, 2026 at 6:54 PM EDT Share Add Us On Google Add as a preferred source on Google COLUMBUS, Ga. (WTVM) - Keeping our skies clear, the ground dry, and the winds breezy for our Thursday. We will start to see those conditions change as we head into the weekend.
 Tonight, lows will drop into the mid-to-upper 50s, with only a few clouds in our skies. Additionally, the winds will die down for the evening, before they pick up in the morning.
 Friday, we will stay dry with clouds building in through the afternoon. Highs will push into the 80s!
 For our weekend, isolated showers are possible for our Halloween. Expecting showers to hold off until after those trick-or-treaters head home! Late night Halloween plans might see a few showers.
 Sunday is our next best shot for some showers, though not everyone will get a shot on the rain.
